title: Model Tampering Attacks Enable More Rigorous Evaluations of LLM Capabilities
reasoning: The paper focuses on safety and security evaluations of LLMs, specifically regarding bioweapons knowledge (WMDP-Bio) and jailbreaking. While these involve identifying 'harmful' content, the study's goal is to evaluate robustness and capability suppression techniques rather than benchmarking moral, ethical, or religious perspectives.
